domestic_evidence: Company website https://www.arabianpetroleum.in/ shows only a GSTIN, no turnover or contract data: 'Arbol Synpro Passenger Car Motor Oil Manufacturer and Supplier from Mumbai GST No. 27AAHCA6383Q1ZW'. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved (zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403; web_search tool was down with 'searx: Connection refused'). Domestic supply therefore rests on the company's own catalogue claim, not on a verifiable transaction record.
note: Real export shipments are documented with dates, destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers (e.g. B/L 1073108 to Bhutan 2026-02-27; B/L 9566855 to Bangladesh 2026-02-11; B/L 9967506 re-export to UAE 2026-02-24), so export_status = confirmed. Note the declared HS 271019 matches the observed base-oil/lubricant lines (27101971, 27101982) and the brake-fluid line carries 38190010 — no HS correction needed for the main product. The same customs page also shows the company as an importer of base oil (ExxonMobil, Ergon, Dukhan), i.e. it is a blender of imported base stock, not an upstream producer. Domestic India-side supply is NOT confirmed: only a GSTIN is public, no turnover band, tender or contract record was obtainable, so it is marked declared_only. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the sources read. Evidence counter vs rows: page claims 1703 shipments / 28 partners, only 5 shipment rows and 5 buyer aggregates were actually visible in the free view.
